lede: The heaviest lift this week is Wednesday's all-day Mountain Village budget work session, where staff and council will go line by line through the 2027 general fund, capital plan, and Tourism Fund — the decisions made in rooms like that one shape everything from road maintenance to what gets built next. The same day, the BOCC holds two public hearings, including one on whether to waive land-use fees for Mountain Village's Ilium Valley affordable housing project — a real question about how much the county is willing to put its thumb on the scale for workforce housing. Wednesday evening there's also a Ballot Measure 5A information meeting at KOTO on Monday, and Oktoberfest kicks off Friday if you need a reason to come up for air.
